![The Genos ask box after typing a slash, listing three skills](/lp/guide/en/skills.webp)

A skill is a note of written steps with a name: your weekly update, your meeting follow-up.

```flow
Write the steps once
Type / and pick it
Approve any change
```

Write and share skills in **Settings → Genos → Skills**. Running one uses AI.
